sources.title: How we built our multi-agent research system

claims.statement: A validator brief states an objective, an output format, the material to check and a clear boundary, because vague briefs make parallel agents duplicate or miss work; the number of agents scales with the task → independence, validator-brief
`git write-tree` creates a tree object from the current index and prints its name, so a temporary index yields the tree of the worktree → tree-hash
`git add -A` updates the index to match the whole working tree, including removals and untracked files, so the hash covers them → tree-hash, Gotchas

sources.title: Xonovex change-workflow conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original rules for the independent check of one work item, built on the contract of **recording-handoff**: the blind first assessment, the pass, fail and blocked results with evidence and limits, the tree hash that binds a verdict to its content, the self-check label and the verdict file that a rerun replaces

claims.statement: The validation runs the entry step of **recording-handoff** first; its verdict is edited in place because git keeps the history; the knowledge skills it loads come from the skills map of the `validating-work-item` phase; only a verdict whose hash matches the delivered tree marks criteria in a pull request description.
